About.lead: Print typography spent five centuries learning how to set a page; browsers learned how to lay out an interface. Postext brings the first to the second.
About.paragraph1: CSS gives you responsive layout — flexbox, grid, columns. But it cannot balance columns, keep a heading with its paragraph, prevent widows and orphans, or float a figure to the head of the next column. These are editorial decisions, refined over centuries of print.
About.paragraph2prefix: Postext bridges that gap. Feed it semantic markdown and a configuration object. It measures text 300–600× faster than the DOM using
About.paragraph2suffix: , then computes the complete page geometry — every line, float and caption — and renders it through HTML, canvas or print-ready PDF backends.

PageMock.title: Why Postext
PageMock.lead: Print typography spent five centuries learning how to set a page; browsers learned how to lay out an interface. Postext brings the first to the second: a layout engine that turns Markdown into pages set to editorial standards.
PageMock.body1: Postext is an open-source layout engine that brings the craft of professional print typography to the web. It takes semantic content written in enriched Markdown and a configuration object, and computes a fully resolved layout in which every line, heading, figure and table has a precise position, measured in real typographic units. That layout is then drawn by three renderers — a live canvas preview, positioned HTML and a print-ready PDF — which all read the same geometry, so what you see on screen is exactly what goes to press.
PageMock.body2: This book is its own demonstration. Its cover, the contents page that numbers itself, the part dividers in three colours, the band that opens each chapter, the running heads at the top of these pages and every figure that floats into place were all laid out by Postext, in your browser, a moment ago. Nothing here was placed by hand: the Markdown only says what things are, and the configuration decides how they look.
PageMock.body3: The book is organised in three parts. Foundations, the part you are in, explains the problem Postext solves and how the engine is built: what goes in, what comes out and what happens in between. The craft is about typography: how a line is set, how a page is framed, where figures and tables go and how a set of chapters becomes a book. In practice turns to the tools: the document format, the Sandbox, the three output formats and the project around them.
PageMock.body4: Each chapter opens with a short introduction on its band, and most of them close their sections with a box headed Try it in the Sandbox: a small experiment you can run on this very book, right now, to see the feature at work. Nothing in them can break anything — the reset button on the guide's row in the Projects panel restores it as it shipped — so change freely. The chapters can be read in any order; when one depends on another, it says so.
PageMock.body5: Modern CSS is a remarkable tool for building user interfaces. Flexbox, Grid, container queries and anchor positioning give developers fine control over how components are arranged in a viewport. But CSS was designed for application layout, and long-form reading needs editorial layout. The two are different problems:
PageMock.body6: The difference is one of kind, not degree. An interface adapts to the window that holds it, and the reader moves through it at will; a page, by contrast, has a fixed size, a beginning and an end, and everything it holds must be resolved within those limits: what fits in this column and what moves to the next, where each figure goes, how each line and each paragraph ends. Those decisions are what make the quality of a book, and none of them can be taken by looking at a single element in isolation.

Features.title: What print typesetters knew all along
Features.justificationDescription: The same optimal line-breaking algorithm TeX uses, with TeX-pattern hyphenation and orphan control — evenly set text blocks with no rivers of whitespace, beyond anything CSS can express.
Features.resourcesDescription: Figures, SVG diagrams and tables float to the top or bottom of columns and pages — the way print floats work — with typed numbering and :ref cross-references that always stay in sync.
Features.tablesDescription: Tables set with independent body and header typography, split across pages with repeated headers, and captions that follow your configuration — numbered and placed alongside the resource they describe.
Features.singleInkDescription: Recolor SVG diagrams to tints of one ink by luminance, so every illustration matches your design — ready for spot-colour printing.
Features.mathDescription: Inline and display equations written in LaTeX, measured and typeset by the engine so they sit on the baseline grid alongside the text.
Features.outputDescription: One layout engine, three renderers. The same computed pages render to HTML, canvas, or print-ready PDF — with bookmarks, CMYK colour and tagged, accessible PDF/UA output.
Features.lead: Six things a page needs that CSS was never designed to decide — computed by the engine, the same way every time.

Bundle.title: One file, the whole book
Bundle.lead: A .postext file carries everything a document needs to be set again, on any machine: an open, editable format that anyone can adopt.
Bundle.paragraph1: Most publishing formats scatter a project. A LaTeX build depends on the fonts and packages installed on one machine, and the native files of the major layout editors link to pictures and typefaces kept outside them. Move the project and something goes missing. We ran into those limits with LaTeX ourselves.
Bundle.paragraph2: A .postext is a plain ZIP archive that anyone can open, read and edit: a JSON manifest, one Markdown file per chapter, and the font files and pictures themselves. The Sandbox exports it, the postext-port agent skill writes it, and postext/bundle opens it in any program to set the same pages again. The format is documented and MIT-licensed, ready for any tool to read and write.

Sandbox.warningsMissingFontDetail: Not loaded — falling back to a system font.
Sandbox.warningsCjkLooseLineDetail: “__text__”: reaching the measure would spread its characters past the limit (half an em, or the maximum justification tracking when it is set), so the line stops short. A long word or web address that cannot break, on the next line, usually causes it.
Sandbox.warningsCjkMarksLeadingDetail: “__text__”: emphasis dots or name and title lines need a line gap of __need__ em, and the paragraph has __gap__ em. Set it with more leading.
Sandbox.warningsRubyLeadingDetail: “__text__”: its ruby readings are __need__ em high and the line gap is __gap__ em, so they touch the line next to them. Set the paragraph with more leading.

Sandbox.warningsMalformedEmbedDetail: This `::` line was not read as an embed, so it prints as text: write `::resource'{'id="…"'}'` alone on its line (double quotes, no other attribute), after a blank line.
Sandbox.warningsFullwidthMarkupDetail: Markup typed with a Chinese or Japanese input method is set as text. Type the ASCII form shown.
Sandbox.warningsAttributeKeyInvalidDetail: Attribute keys are written in ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, so this attribute is ignored. Values may be in any script.
Sandbox.warningsNumberingInvalidFormatDetail: The `format` attribute of `:::numbering` is not a numbering format, so the current format is kept. Use decimal, lower-roman, upper-roman, lower-alpha, upper-alpha or an East Asian style such as simp-chinese-informal, trad-chinese-informal, cjk-decimal or circled-decimal (any spelling in Configuration › Numbering format spellings works too, such as roman-lower, i or 一).
Sandbox.warningsNumberingInvalidStartAtDetail: The `startAt` attribute of `:::numbering` must be an integer greater than or equal to 1.
Sandbox.warningsSpaceInvalidLinesDetail: The `lines` attribute must be a number greater than 0 and at most 20. One line is used instead.
Sandbox.warningsParityCascadeDetail: Heading `breakBefore.parity` is producing more than two consecutive blank padding pages — likely a misconfiguration.
Sandbox.warningsAlphaPdfOverflowDetail: Alphabetic page numbering exceeds Z. The PDF reader will display the literal label (AA, AB, …) via per-page entries.
Sandbox.warningsCalloutOverflowDetail: page __page__ · __mm__ mm past the column — the box is taller than a column and no cut can split it (a figure, table or column group taller than the column, or too high a minimum of lines to split): shorten it
Sandbox.warningsHeadingDesignCutDetail: On page __page__ the heading's design runs __mm__ mm past the foot of the page (or of its column), and that part of it is cut off. The text after the heading starts on the next page or column; shorten the design or give the page more room.
Sandbox.warningsSideColumnPercentClampedDetail: Leaves one of the columns with no width, or is not a number: the side column takes __used__ % of the content area instead.
Sandbox.warningsCjkGridClampedDetail: Does not fit inside the margins: the grid is set with __used__.

Sandbox.mathMarginBottomTooltip: Bottom margin for $$…$$ display blocks (baseline grid snap may enlarge it)
Sandbox.mathIndentAfterDisplayTooltip: Indent a paragraph that follows a display formula, as any other. Off: set it flush, as the rest of the sentence the formula interrupted. A formula written inside a paragraph (no blank line above it nor below it) is always followed flush.
Sandbox.mathKeepWithLeadInTooltip: When a display formula does not fit under the last line of the paragraph before it, take that line on to the next column or page with the formula, as TeX does. Off: the formula moves on alone.
Sandbox.footnotesPlacementTooltip: Where the notes cited with [^id] are set: at the foot of the column that cites them, or all together after the chapter's last block.
Sandbox.footnotesNumberingTooltip: Start the note numbers again at each chapter, run them on through the document (and the book), or start again on every page or in every column, as Chinese books do. Per page and per column count the notes where the layout sets them, at the column foot.
Sandbox.footnotesNumberFormatTooltip: How the note numbers are written: 1, i, a, the Chinese numerals or circled numbers (①). Circled numbers past 50 are written as 51, 52…
Sandbox.footnotesMarkerPositionTooltip: How the number that cites a note is set in the text: raised as a superscript, or on the baseline as Chinese books set ①. Automatic sets circled numbers inline and the rest as superscripts. The number that opens the note follows.
Sandbox.footnotesMarkerSizeTooltip: Size of an inline marker; em is relative to the text around it. Full size by default; 0.75em is a common reduced size.
Sandbox.footnotesChapterEndAlignTooltip: At the end of the chapter: set the notes at the foot of the column, with the leftover room between the text and them, or right under the text.
Sandbox.footnotesFontSizeTooltip: Size of the note text; em is relative to the body size.
Sandbox.footnotesLineHeightTooltip: Leading of the note text; em is relative to the note size.
Sandbox.footnotesColorTooltip: Colour of the note text. Unset, the body colour.
Sandbox.footnotesHangingIndentTooltip: Indent of a note's turnover lines, so they align past its number.
Sandbox.footnotesSpaceBetweenTooltip: Vertical space between two notes of a column.
Sandbox.footnotesSpaceAboveTooltip: Space between the last line of text and the separator rule; em is relative to the body size.
Sandbox.footnotesSpaceBelowRuleTooltip: Space between the separator rule and the first note.
Sandbox.footnotesSeparatorTooltip: Draw a short rule between the text and the notes of a column.
Sandbox.footnotesSeparatorWidthTooltip: Length of the rule as a fraction of the column width (0 to 1).
Sandbox.footnotesSeparatorColorTooltip: Colour of the separator rule. Unset, the note text colour.
Sandbox.cjkRegionTooltip: The Chinese conventions the text follows. Auto reads them from the document language: zh, zh-Hans and zh-CN follow the mainland, zh-Hant and zh-TW Taiwan, zh-HK and zh-MO Hong Kong; any other language, the mainland.
Sandbox.cjkLineBreakTooltip: Which marks may not open or close a line of Chinese, Japanese or Korean text. Basic keeps pause and stop marks (、，。？！), closing brackets and quotes, connectors and the interpunct off the start of a line, and opening brackets and quotes off its end. GB also keeps the solidus off both ends (GB/T 15834). Strict also keeps —— and …… off the start. None breaks between any two characters, as newspapers in Taiwan and Hong Kong do. At every level —— and …… never split and a number keeps its signs. Auto: GB for the mainland, Basic for Taiwan and Hong Kong.
Sandbox.writingModeTooltip: How lines run. Vertical sets Chinese and Japanese text top to bottom, each line to the left of the one before. Columns become tiers stacked top to bottom, figures and tables stay upright, and running heads and folios stay horizontal. Tiers are not balanced unless column balancing is turned on.
Sandbox.writingModeHorizontalDescription: Lines run left to right, one under the other.
Sandbox.writingModeVerticalDescription: Lines run top to bottom, each to the left of the one before.
Sandbox.bindingTooltip: The edge the book is bound on. A book bound on the right, as vertical Chinese and Japanese books are, opens on a left page: page 1 is still odd, spreads read 3 | 2, the arrows turn pages leftward and an odd page has its inner margin on its right. Auto binds vertical books on the right.
Sandbox.cjkPunctuationWidthTooltip: How wide the full-width marks are set. Kaiming (开明式): 。？！ take a full em (half at the end of a line), the other marks and every bracket and quote half an em; most mainland books use it. Full width (全角式): every mark a full em. Half at line end (行末半角): a full em inside the line, half at its end, as GB/T 15834 §5.1.10 reads. Half width (半角式): every mark half an em, as in dictionaries. Marks set in the middle of their box (Taiwan, Hong Kong) give up a quarter em on each side, and there ？！ always keep a full em. Auto: Kaiming for the mainland, full width for Taiwan and Hong Kong.
Sandbox.cjkCompressAdjacentTooltip: Two marks that meet (。」, 》（, ：“) give up the half em of blank between them, so the pair takes one and a half ems instead of two. Auto: on for the mainland and Hong Kong, off for Taiwan.
Sandbox.cjkTrimLineStartTooltip: An opening bracket or quote that starts a line gives up its leading half em, so its ink lines up with the edge of the text (on a first line it sits half an em into the indent); a closing one that ends a line gives up its trailing half. Auto: on for the mainland and Hong Kong, off for Taiwan.
Sandbox.cjkHangingTooltip: Whether a comma or a full stop may hang past the end of the line instead of going down to the next one with the character before it. None: never. Allow: one of 、，。 (on the mainland also ；：？！) hangs when compressing the line cannot take it in; never in horizontal Taiwan or Hong Kong text. Force: such a mark hangs whenever it ends a line. Never when another mark touches it.
Sandbox.cjkLatinSpacingTooltip: The space set between a Chinese character and a Latin letter or digit next to it (用 iPhone 拍照), in ems of the text size or any length; 0 turns it off. None at the start or end of a line, next to a Chinese mark or inside Chinese brackets. A space typed there is replaced, not added to. On a justified line it grows up to half an em before the characters are spread, and shrinks to an eighth of an em when the line takes one more character. Default 0.25 em.
Sandbox.cjkUprightDigitsTooltip: Vertical text: a number of at most this many digits is set side by side in one upright cell (tate-chu-yoko): in 2026年9月28日, 9 and 28 stand upright and 2026 runs sideways. The whole number or none of it; a number touching a Latin letter (A4) or with a decimal point or digit grouping (3.14, 10,000) runs sideways, and so does one inside a Latin sentence, between two Latin words (chapters 49 and 32). Mark a run by hand with :tcy[…], :upright[…] or :sideways[…]. No effect in horizontal text. Default 2.
Sandbox.cjkGridDescription: The type area in characters per line and lines per page (字格, 版心).
Sandbox.cjkGridEnabled: Set the type area by the grid
Sandbox.cjkGridEnabledTooltip: Derive the type area from the body size: each column is as many ems wide as characters per line, the text as many lines tall as lines per page, and with two columns the gutter is a whole number of ems. The margins in Page act as minimums: the grid sits in the middle of what they leave. A grid that does not fit is reduced and reported in Checks.
Sandbox.cjkGridCharsTooltip: Characters of the body size in one line of a column. 0: as many as the margins leave room for.
Sandbox.cjkGridLinesTooltip: Lines of the body line height in one column. 0: as many as the margins leave room for.
Sandbox.cjkGridShowTooltip: Draw a square for every character position over the type area (稿纸), on screen only; the PDF leaves it out.
Sandbox.cjkGridReadout: __chars__ 字 × __lines__ 行 · 版心 __width__ × __height__ mm
Sandbox.cjkGridMargins: Margins from the grid: top __top__, bottom __bottom__, left __left__, right __right__ mm.
Sandbox.cjkNotCjkHint: These settings affect Chinese, Japanese and Korean text. Document language: __language__.
Sandbox.chineseDefaultsTooltip: Sets the book up for Chinese in one step: the document language, Noto Serif and Noto Sans in the chosen characters, a two-em first-line indent, justified text without hyphenation, 图 and 表 (圖 and 表 in Traditional) numbered by chapter, captions set as 图1-1　标题, chapters numbered 第一章 and lists numbered 一、（一）1.（1）①, and footnotes marked ① on the baseline, numbered again on every page. The list of changes comes first, and settings you changed yourself stay as they are unless you tick them.
Sandbox.chineseDefaultsNothing: The book already has every Chinese default.
Sandbox.chineseDefaultsUndonePartial: Chinese defaults undone, except the settings you have changed since.
Sandbox.pageMarginsFromGrid: The character grid sets the margins (East Asian typography): top __top__, bottom __bottom__, left __left__, right __right__ mm. These act as minimums.
Sandbox.cjkEmphasisTooltip: What *…* does to Chinese characters. Emphasis dots sets a dot under each one (right of it in vertical text), as :dots[…] does, and Latin letters in the same emphasis stay italic. Italic slants them, which a Chinese face can only fake. Auto: dots when the document language is Chinese.
Sandbox.cjkBookTitleMarkTooltip: What :book[…] prints for a title. Brackets sets 《》 around it (〈〉 for a title inside another); the wavy line is drawn under it (left of it in vertical text), as classical and Taiwan editions do; None prints the bare title. Auto: brackets for the mainland, the wavy line for Taiwan and Hong Kong.
Sandbox.cjkAnnotationColorTooltip: Colour of the emphasis dots and of the proper-name and book-title lines. Ruby readings and warichu notes take it too unless they set their own. By default, the colour of the text they mark.
Sandbox.cjkRubyDescription: Readings written :ruby[紅樓]'{'rt="hóng lóu"'}' or '{'紅樓|hóng|lóu'}': pinyin over the text, zhuyin right of each character.
Sandbox.cjkRubyFontTooltip: Face of the readings. Pinyin often reads better in a sans face with a single-storey a and g. By default, the face of the text.
Sandbox.cjkRubySizeTooltip: Size of the readings, in em of the text; zhuyin is set at 60 % of it. Readings sit in the line gap, so the text needs at least this much space between its lines: the warnings list paragraphs that are tighter.
Sandbox.cjkRubyColorTooltip: By default, the mark colour, else the text colour.
Sandbox.cjkRubyPositionTooltip: Where readings go when a :ruby does not say so itself (pos). In vertical text, over is the right side and under the left.
Sandbox.cjkWarichuDescription: Two-row notes set inside the line with :warichu[…], as classical editions carry their commentary.
Sandbox.cjkWarichuSizeTooltip: Size of the note characters, in em of the text. At half an em the two rows fill the em of the line.
Sandbox.cjkWarichuColorTooltip: Colour of the notes and their brackets (vermilion for a commentary). By default, the mark colour, else the text colour.
Sandbox.cjkWarichuOpenTooltip: Set at the text size before the first row of a note, such as 〔 or （. Empty: none. The open attribute of a note wins.
Sandbox.cjkWarichuCloseTooltip: Set after the last row of a note. The close attribute of a note wins.
Sandbox.bodyFontTooltip: Font family for the body text
Sandbox.bodyFontSizeTooltip: Font size for the body text
Sandbox.bodyLineHeightTooltip: Vertical spacing between lines of text
Sandbox.bodyParagraphSpacingTooltip: When enabled, insert a blank line (equal to line height) between consecutive paragraphs
Sandbox.bodyBoldColorTooltip: Default color for bold text in body paragraphs. When unset, inherits the text color.
Sandbox.bodyItalicColorTooltip: Default color for italic text in body paragraphs. When unset, inherits the text color.
Sandbox.bodyReferenceColorTooltip: Color of inline references (e.g. "Fig. 1.7"). Defaults to the bold/emphasis color.
Sandbox.bodyReferenceBoldTooltip: Render inline references in the bold font. On by default.
Sandbox.bodyReferenceItalicTooltip: Render inline references in italics. Off by default.
Sandbox.bodyTextAlignTooltip: Horizontal alignment of body text paragraphs
Sandbox.bodyHyphenationTooltip: Enable automatic hyphenation for justified text
Sandbox.bodyBoldFontWeightTooltip: Weight for bold text in body paragraphs (100-900)
Sandbox.bodyHyphenationRaggedTooltip: Also hyphenate text set ragged: the body when it is not justified, and the ragged paragraph styles and boxes whose hyphenation is on. Only words that would leave a gap wider than the hyphenation zone are divided
Sandbox.bodyHyphenationZoneTooltip: A word that does not fit is hyphenated only when moving it whole to the next line would leave more than this much space at the end of the line. A wider zone gives fewer hyphens and a more ragged edge; 0 hyphenates wherever a word does not fit
Sandbox.bodyHyphenateCompoundsTooltip: Let the dictionary divide the words of a compound joined by a hyphen (af-ter-dinner). Off: such a word breaks only after its own hyphen (after- | dinner), as TeX does. A soft hyphen typed in the word still breaks there.
Sandbox.bodyFirstLineIndentTooltip: Indent applied to the first line of each paragraph
Sandbox.bodyHangingIndentTooltip: When enabled, all lines except the first are indented (French indent)
Sandbox.bodyIndentAfterHeadingTooltip: When disabled, the first paragraph immediately following a heading is rendered without first-line indent — a typographic convention common in scientific publications and many book styles
Sandbox.bodyMaxWordSpacingTooltip: Maximum allowed word-spacing when justifying, expressed as a multiplier of the natural space width. The engine prefers breaks that stay within this bound (best-effort via hyphenation).
Sandbox.bodyMinWordSpacingTooltip: Minimum allowed word-spacing when justifying, expressed as a multiplier of the natural space width.
Sandbox.bodyMaxJustifyTrackingTooltip: Tracking (letter spacing) a justified line may add or remove, in thousandths of an em (as in InDesign: 10 = 0.01 em per letter), when its word spaces alone would stretch past the maximum word spacing or shrink past the minimum. Lines within those limits take none. 0, the default, turns it off. Needs optimal line breaking.
Sandbox.bodyOptimalLineBreakingTooltip: Use the Knuth-Plass algorithm for globally optimal line breaks instead of greedy first-fit.
Sandbox.bodyHyphenateAcrossColumnsTooltip: Let a column or a page end on a hyphenated word. Off: the paragraph that crosses the column break is broken again so that its last line in the column ends on a whole word, where the word-spacing limits allow it; in ragged text only the line breaks move. Needs optimal line breaking, and for ragged text Optimal Breaking of Ragged Text.
Sandbox.bodyOptimalRaggedTooltip: Break ragged text (set left, right or centred) with Knuth-Plass too. Word spaces keep their width, the ragged edge comes out more even, and the rules for short last lines work as on justified text. Off: each line is filled before the next, as up to postext 1.4. Books saved before postext 1.5 that set text ragged open with it off. Needs optimal line breaking.
Sandbox.bodyBreakAfterDashesTooltip: Let a line end after an em or en dash set between two words (say—that’s), in optimal line breaking too. Never after a dash that opens an aside or a line of dialogue, nor inside a range of numbers (1914–1918). Off: as up to postext 1.4. Books saved before postext 1.5 that set such a dash open with it off.
Sandbox.bodyBreakAfterHyphensTooltip: Let a line end after the hyphen of a compound (well- | known) in every paragraph set with optimal line breaking. Off: as up to postext 1.4, where a justified paragraph without bold, italics or other formatting never broke there. Books saved before postext 1.5 that set a compound open with it off.
Sandbox.bodyRepeatHyphenTooltip: Start the line after a break at the hyphen of a compound with a hyphen too (vencer- | -se), as Portuguese spelling and the Spanish Academy ask. A web address never gets one.
Sandbox.bodyBlockquoteColorTooltip: Text color of blockquotes (lines that start with >). Grey (#666666) by default. Link it to a palette color to follow the palette.
Sandbox.bodyBlockquoteItalicTooltip: Set blockquotes in italics; text in *italics* inside them turns back to upright. On by default.
Sandbox.bodyBlockquoteIndentTooltip: How far every line of a blockquote is set in from the left edge of the column or box. 0 by default.
Sandbox.bodyBlockquoteFirstLineIndentTooltip: Indent of the first line of each quoted paragraph, counted from the blockquote indent. Until you set it, the body text’s first line indent applies.
Sandbox.bodyAvoidOrphansTooltip: Discourage leaving a paragraph's last line(s) alone at the top of the next column.
Sandbox.bodyOrphanMinLinesTooltip: Minimum number of lines required at the top of the next column when a paragraph is split.
Sandbox.bodyOrphanPenaltyTooltip: Demerit added when the orphan constraint is violated. Higher = stronger avoidance; 0 disables the penalty.
Sandbox.bodyAvoidWidowsTooltip: Discourage starting a paragraph with a single line at the bottom of the current column.
Sandbox.bodyWidowMinLinesTooltip: Minimum number of lines required at the bottom of the current column when a paragraph is split.
Sandbox.bodyWidowPenaltyTooltip: Demerit added when the widow constraint is violated. Higher = stronger avoidance; 0 disables the penalty.
Sandbox.bodySlackWeightTooltip: Cost per squared unit of unused column height. Higher values make the layout prefer filling columns; 0 disables the pressure.
Sandbox.bodyAvoidRuntsTooltip: Discourage paragraphs from ending with a very short last line (e.g. a single short word). In Chinese, Japanese and Korean text, a last line of one character (孤字) takes the last character of the line above.
Sandbox.bodyRuntMinCharactersTooltip: Width threshold for the last line, counted in word spaces (about half a letter each): the default 20 catches last lines under roughly 8 to 12 letters. For about N letters, use 2 × N.
Sandbox.bodyRuntPenaltyTooltip: Demerit added when the final line of a paragraph is shorter than the runt threshold. Higher = stronger avoidance; 0 disables the penalty.
Sandbox.bodyGradedRuntPenaltyTooltip: Price a runt by how short its last line falls under the threshold, so a two-word ending costs less than a one-word one and wins when a line above can give a word up. Off: every runt costs the full penalty.
Sandbox.bodyAvoidRuntsInListsTooltip: When on, list items get the same runt penalty as paragraphs. Turn off to limit runt avoidance to regular paragraphs only.
Sandbox.bodyAvoidOrphansInListsTooltip: When on, list items get the same orphan protection as paragraphs. Turn off to limit orphan avoidance to regular paragraphs only.
Sandbox.bodyAvoidWidowsInListsTooltip: When on, list items get the same widow protection as paragraphs. Turn off to limit widow avoidance to regular paragraphs only.
Sandbox.bodyKeepColonWithListTooltip: When a paragraph ending in a colon introduces a list, keep the colon-bearing line in the same column as the first list item. If the list would not fit after the paragraph, only the last line (or the whole paragraph, if single-line) is pushed to the next column.
Sandbox.bodyColonListRoomTooltip: How much room the colon line needs under it to stay in its column. What the first item needs: the lines the orphan and widow rules for lists would leave of the first item at the foot of the column, all of it when they keep it whole. One line: a single line is enough, as up to postext 1.4, so a two-line first item those rules keep whole goes on without the colon line. Books saved before postext 1.5 open with One line.
Sandbox.headingsFontTooltip: Default font family for all headings
Sandbox.headingsLineHeightTooltip: Default line height for all headings
Sandbox.headingsFontWeightTooltip: Default font weight for all headings (100-900)
Sandbox.headingsMarginTopTooltip: Default space above headings (skipped at top of column)
Sandbox.headingsKeepWithNextTooltip: Prevent a heading from being placed alone at the end of a column or page. If the following text would not have at least one line of room after the heading, the heading moves to the next column with it.
Sandbox.headingsKeepWithNextSplitTooltip: When the paragraph under a heading at the foot of a column does not fit, it splits there. By the rules: the most lines that fit, keeping the widow minimum under the heading and the orphan minimum at the head of the next column; when no split keeps both, the heading moves on with its paragraph. Fill the column: as many lines as fit, however few go on (the rule up to postext 1.4).
Sandbox.headingsSnapToGrid: Snap back to the grid after headings
Sandbox.headingsSnapToGridTooltip: Round the space under a heading up to whole grid lines so the text that follows sits on the baseline grid. Off keeps the exact margin: the text may sit off the grid until the next snap point (the end of a list, a container, display math)
Sandbox.headingsInlineMarksTooltip: Set the italic, bold, superscripts, subscripts, small capitals and links written in a heading, as a paragraph does; the contents keep its bold and italic. Italic in an italic heading comes out upright. Off prints the marked words in the heading's own style. Books saved before this option keep it off when their headings carry marks
Sandbox.headingFontSizeTooltip: Font size for this heading level
Sandbox.headingLineHeightTooltip: Override line height for this heading level
Sandbox.headingFontTooltip: Override font for this heading level
Sandbox.headingColorTooltip: Override color for this heading level
Sandbox.headingFontWeightTooltip: Override font weight for this heading level
Sandbox.headingMarginTopTooltip: Space above this heading level (skipped at top of column)
Sandbox.headingMarginBottomTooltip: Minimum space below this heading level
Sandbox.headingNumberingTemplateTooltip: Template for this level's number prefix. Use '{'N'}' for the counter at level N, '{'N:style'}' to pick a numeral style (1, 01, A, a, I, i; 一, 〇, 壹 and ① for Chinese numerals, digits, financial numerals and circled digits), or spell it out with words or ordinal (Words, WORDS: the case of the style sets the case of the words). Examples: "'{'1'}'.", "'{'1'}'.'{'2'}'", "'{'2:A'}'.'{'3'}'", "Chapter '{'1:Words'}'", "第'{'1:一'}'回". Empty = no numbering.
Sandbox.headingNumberSeparatorTooltip: What separates the number from the title: in the column, in the page-wide opener, in the running heads and in the PDF bookmarks. Chinese chapter heads take an ideographic space or nothing: 第一回　甄士隱夢幻識通靈.
Sandbox.headingLevelSnapToGrid: Snap back to the grid after this heading
Sandbox.headingLevelSnapToGridTooltip: Round the space under headings of this level up to whole grid lines, so the text that follows sits on the baseline grid. Off keeps the exact margin (a line and a half under a heading, say): the text may sit off the grid until the next snap point. Unset, it follows the headings setting
Sandbox.headingItalicTooltip: Render this heading level in italic style
Sandbox.headingTextTransformTooltip: Case transform applied to the heading title. The numbering prefix is kept as written
Sandbox.headingLetterSpacingTooltip: Extra space after every letter of the heading, the numbering included (tracking). Negative tightens a display size; capitals usually want a little. Ignored when the level is drawn from its advanced design
Sandbox.headingHiddenTooltip: The heading prints nothing and takes no room, but still does the rest: its page break, the section of its style, the numbering, the contents, the running heads and the PDF bookmarks. For a dedication or a colophon. A heading may override it with hidden="true" or hidden="false"
Sandbox.headingAdvancedMinHeightTooltip: Minimum height reserved for the heading in the column flow. The body starts below the taller of the design content and this value, so an opener can push the text down even when its elements are short or anchored to the page
Sandbox.headingBreakBeforeTooltip: Force a page break before each heading of this level
Sandbox.headingBreakBeforeParityTooltip: Restrict which side of the spread this heading can open on — inserts a blank page when needed
Sandbox.headingSpanTooltip: Column: headings flow inline with the body text. Full page: headings become chapter-opener bands that span the full page width (combine with break-before).
Sandbox.headingAdvancedDesignTooltip: Enable a free-composition design slot for this heading level. Edit the slot elements in your config to compose text, rules, and boxes with anchor-based positioning.
Sandbox.headingAdvancedDesignInfo: Edit the opener design via config. Include a text element with '{titleText}' to render the heading.
Sandbox.unorderedListsFontTooltip: Default font family used to render list bullets (inherits from body text when unset)
Sandbox.unorderedListsColorTooltip: Default color for list bullets (inherits from body text when unset)
Sandbox.unorderedListsFontWeightTooltip: Default font weight for list bullets (100-900)
Sandbox.unorderedListsBulletCharTooltip: Glyph used as the default bullet for every depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListsBulletFontSizeTooltip: Font size for the bullet glyph (em is relative to body text)
Sandbox.unorderedListsGapTooltip: Horizontal distance between the bullet and the start of the item text
Sandbox.unorderedListsIndentTooltip: Base indent per depth level — level N defaults to this value × N. Set to 0 to pin bullets to the column edge.
Sandbox.unorderedListsBulletVerticalOffsetToolti: Fine-tune bullet vertical position. Negative values raise the bullet, positive values lower it.
Sandbox.unorderedListsMarginTopTooltip: Space before the first item of a list
Sandbox.unorderedListsMarginBottomTooltip: Space after the last item of a list
Sandbox.unorderedListsItemSpacingTooltip: Extra vertical space between consecutive list items. Around a list nested in another, the outer list’s spacing applies on both sides
Sandbox.unorderedListsSnapTopToGridTooltip: Round the space above a list up so its first item sits on the baseline grid; the top margin becomes a minimum. The end of a list snaps back to the grid either way
Sandbox.unorderedListsHangingIndentTooltip: When enabled, wrapped lines align to the text start instead of the bullet column
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelBulletCharTooltip: Override the bullet character for this depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelFontTooltip: Override the bullet font for this depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelFontSizeTooltip: Override the bullet font size for this depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelColorTooltip: Override the bullet color for this depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelFontWeightTooltip: Override the bullet font weight for this depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelItalicTooltip: Render this depth level bullet in italic
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelIndentTooltip: Horizontal indent from the column edge to the bullet for this depth level
Sandbox.unorderedListLevelVerticalOffsetTooltip: Override vertical nudge for this depth level. Negative = up, positive = down.
Sandbox.taskCheckboxCharTooltip: Glyph used as the checkbox for pending task items (`- [ ]`).
Sandbox.taskCheckedCharTooltip: Glyph used as the checkbox for completed task items (`- [x]`).
Sandbox.taskCompletedStrikethroughTooltip: Draw a line through the text of completed task items.
Sandbox.taskCompletedColorTooltip: Text color for completed task items. When unset, the body color is used.
Sandbox.orderedListsFontTooltip: Default font family used to render ordered list numbers (inherits from body text when unset).
Sandbox.orderedListsColorTooltip: Default color for ordered list numbers (inherits from body text when unset).
Sandbox.orderedListsFontWeightTooltip: Default font weight for ordered list numbers (100-900).
Sandbox.orderedListsItalicTooltip: Render ordered list numbers in italic.
Sandbox.orderedListsNumberFormatTooltip: Default numbering format for every depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListsPrefixTooltip: Character(s) set before the number, in the separator’s style. With `（` here and `）` as the separator, a list reads （一）（二）.
Sandbox.orderedListsNumberFontSizeTooltip: Font size for the numbers (em is relative to body text).
Sandbox.orderedListsGapTooltip: Horizontal distance between the number+separator and the start of the item text.
Sandbox.orderedListsIndentTooltip: Base indent for level 1. Deeper levels cascade from their parent unless overridden.
Sandbox.orderedListsNumberVerticalOffsetTooltip: Fine-tune number vertical position. Negative values raise, positive values lower.
Sandbox.orderedListsMarginTopTooltip: Space before the first item of a list.
Sandbox.orderedListsMarginBottomTooltip: Space after the last item of a list.
Sandbox.orderedListsItemSpacingTooltip: Extra vertical space between consecutive list items. Around a list nested in another, the outer list’s spacing applies on both sides.
Sandbox.orderedListsSnapTopToGridTooltip: Round the space above a list up so its first item sits on the baseline grid; the top margin becomes a minimum. The end of a list snaps back to the grid either way
Sandbox.orderedListsNumberWidthTooltip: Where the text of an item starts. Per run: after the widest number of its own run, so a list broken by a figure or a paragraph can start its text further right after the break. Per level: after the widest number at that depth in the chapter, so every list lines up
Sandbox.orderedListsHangingIndentTooltip: When enabled, wrapped lines align to the text start instead of the number column.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelNumberFormatTooltip: Override the numbering format for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelSeparatorTooltip: Override the separator for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelFontTooltip: Override the number font for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelFontSizeTooltip: Override the number font size for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelColorTooltip: Override the number color for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelFontWeightTooltip: Override the number font weight for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelItalicTooltip: Render this depth level number in italic.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelIndentTooltip: Horizontal indent from the column edge to the number column for this depth level.
Sandbox.orderedListLevelVerticalOffsetTooltip: Override vertical nudge for this depth level. Negative = up, positive = down.
Sandbox.orderedListsSeparatorFontTooltip: Font family of the separator run. Inherits the number font
Sandbox.orderedListsSeparatorColorTooltip: Color of the separator. Inherits the number color
Sandbox.orderedListsSeparatorFontWeightTooltip: Font weight of the separator (100–900). Inherits the number weight
Sandbox.orderedListsSeparatorItalicTooltip: Render the separator in italic. Inherits the number setting
Sandbox.orderedListsSeparatorGapTooltip: Space between the number and the separator
Sandbox.layoutTypeTooltip: Column layout mode for the content area
Sandbox.sideColumnPercentTooltip: Width of the side column as a percentage of the content area
Sandbox.sideColumnRoleTooltip: Whether body text flows into the side column after the main column, or the side column is reserved for the figures, tables and boxes placed with span "side" (a margin column)
Sandbox.sideColumnSideTooltip: Which edge of the page the side column sits at. Outer and inner follow the page parity when the margins are mirrored
Sandbox.columnRuleTooltip: Show a vertical line between columns
Sandbox.columnRuleColorTooltip: Color of the column rule line
Sandbox.columnRuleLineWidthTooltip: Thickness of the column rule line
Sandbox.balanceColumnsTooltip: Add baseline-grid lines above headings so columns end flush with the page bottom
Sandbox.balanceColumnsMaxLinesTooltip: Maximum extra grid lines that may be added above a single heading
Sandbox.balanceAfterListsTooltip: Add a baseline-grid line after a list ends when the column needs to reach the page bottom
Sandbox.balanceAfterFloatsTooltip: Add a baseline-grid line between a figure or table at the head of a column and the text under it when the column needs to reach the page bottom
Sandbox.balanceLooseParagraphsTooltip: As a last resort, re-break one paragraph per column one line looser, within the maximum word spacing
Sandbox.balanceMaxLooseParagraphsTooltip: How many paragraphs of one short column may run a line long (one extra line each, longest first)
Sandbox.balanceTrackParagraphsTooltip: When word spacing alone cannot gain the line, let the paragraph take the smallest positive tracking that does
Sandbox.balanceTrailingTooltip: When a chapter or the document ends before the page is full, cut its last columns level so they end at the same height (a short bibliography no longer fills the first column and leaves the last one half empty). Columns that already end within a line of each other are left as they are
Sandbox.balanceBeforeSpan: Level columns before a page-wide box
Sandbox.balanceBeforeSpanTooltip: When a page-wide callout does not fit under the current columns and has to move on (or split), cut the columns it leaves level, so the text ends at the same height in every column and the box — or the part of it that fits — sits beneath
Sandbox.balanceClosingBoxTooltip: When a callout box that ends a short column moves down so its foot meets the last grid line. First: before any other lever, taking the whole gap. After the other levers: headings, list ends and the space under figures take whole lines first, and the box only what they leave, so it stays closer to the text above it. Never: the box keeps the room under its foot, though the levers above it can still move it down by whole lines
Sandbox.balanceMaxTrackingTooltip: Upper limit for that tracking, in thousandths of an em per character (10 = 0.01 em, the usual editorial tolerance)
Sandbox.canvasRegenerateTooltip: Rebuild the layout from the current markdown and configuration
Sandbox.htmlRegenerateTooltip: Rebuild the layout from the current markdown and configuration
Sandbox.htmlViewerMaxCharsPerLineTooltip: Target line length used to size the reading column — drives both single-column width and how many columns fit in multi-column mode
Sandbox.htmlViewerColumnGapTooltip: Horizontal spacing between columns when the HTML viewer is in multi-column mode
Sandbox.htmlViewerOptimalLineBreakingTooltip: Use Knuth-Plass optimal line breaking in the HTML viewer. Off by default for performance — the global body-text setting is overridden here only for HTML rendering
Sandbox.heading: Heading

Sandbox.spaceDirectiveTooltip: Insert a `:::space` directive (one blank line) at the current line

Sandbox.customFontsTooltip: Upload font files you own a licence for; they can then be chosen anywhere a typeface is picked.
Sandbox.customFontsDeleteFamilyConfirm: Delete this font family and all its variants?
Sandbox.warningsMissingFontVariantDetail: The document uses a weight/style combination that has no uploaded file.
Sandbox.warningsMissingFontFamilyDetail: Not a Google Font and not uploaded as a custom font.
Sandbox.warningsDuplicateFontVariantDetail: Multiple files share the same weight/style — only one will be used.
Sandbox.warningsFontFamilyStackTitle: Font stack in a font family
Sandbox.warningsFontFamilyStackDetail: A font family names one family: the text is set in "__used__", the first of the list.
Sandbox.warningsUnknownNumberFormatDetail: Not a numbering format; numbered in __used__. Use decimal, lower-roman, upper-roman, lower-alpha, upper-alpha or an East Asian style such as simp-chinese-informal or circled-decimal.
Sandbox.warningsUnknownConfigKeyDetail: The engine has no such setting and ignores it.
Sandbox.colorPaletteTooltip: Named colors reusable across all color fields. Changing an entry updates every reference.
Sandbox.colorPaletteDeleteInUseNote: These properties will keep the color but lose the link.
Sandbox.headerFooterTooltip: Configure per-page header and footer slots with text and rule elements. Placeholders like '{'pageNumber'}', '{'chapterTitle'}', and '{'totalPages'}' are resolved per page.
Sandbox.headerFooterAddForeEdgeTooltip: Adds the chapter title and the folio set vertically down the outer margin of every page, as vertical Chinese and Japanese books print them: the title four characters below the head of the type area, the folio five above its foot, both at 80 % of the body size. The page number prints in the page numbering format (Chinese numerals with trad-chinese-informal).
Sandbox.headerFooterImageResourceTooltip: A bitmap or SVG resource of the book. Upload a new one here, or open the chosen one in the Resources panel to replace its file.
Sandbox.headerFooterImageDecorativeTooltip: Decoration only: the picture gives no alternative text to HTML or a tagged PDF, even when its resource has one. Otherwise the resource's alt text, else its caption, describes the picture to a screen reader.
Sandbox.headerFooterElementContentTooltip: Text to render. Use '{'name'}' for placeholders, '{{' and '}}' to emit literal braces.
Sandbox.headerFooterElementMarginFromBodyTooltip: Distance between the element and the body text. In the header this is the gap above the body; in the footer, the gap below.
Sandbox.headerFooterElementMarginFromEdgeTooltip: Horizontal inset from the aligned edge. When aligned left, distance from the left content edge; when aligned right, from the right.
Sandbox.headerFooterElementPagesTooltip: Page roles this element renders on: every page, body pages only, chapter openers, part dividers or blank pages. Combined with the parity filter
Sandbox.headerFooterFrameEdgeTooltip: Edge or corner of the page (or bleed) frame the element hangs from. Offsets move it from there: positive X goes right, positive Y goes down
Sandbox.partsBreakBeforeParityTooltip: Which side of the spread a part opens on — inserts a blank page when needed. Defaults to odd (right-hand)
Sandbox.partsBreakAfterTooltip: Move the content that follows the part to a fresh page
Sandbox.partsBreakAfterParityTooltip: Which side of the spread the content after the part resumes on. With "any side", the next chapter break-before parity decides whether a blank verso follows
Sandbox.partsMarginsTooltip: Body area of the part page. Inherits the page margins until overridden
Sandbox.partsDesignInfo: Text, rules and boxes laid out against the page trim box. Purely decorative — raise the top margin to leave room for it. When empty, '{number}' '{titleText}' is set in the H1 typography.
Sandbox.partsVersoDesignInfo: Design of the blank page that follows a part page (the back of the divider leaf). Same container and placeholders as the opener design; leave empty for a plain verso.
Sandbox.partsBodyFontTooltip: Typeface of the blocks inside the part. Inherits the body text font
Sandbox.partsBodyFontSizeTooltip: Font size of the blocks inside the part. Inherits the body text size
Sandbox.partsBodyLineHeightTooltip: Line height of the blocks inside the part. Inherits the body text line height
Sandbox.partsBodyColorTooltip: Text color inside the part. Inherits the body text color
Sandbox.partsBodyTextAlignTooltip: Horizontal alignment of the blocks inside the part. Inherits the body text alignment
Sandbox.partsBodyBulletColorTooltip: Bullet color of unordered lists inside the part. Inherits the unordered lists color
Sandbox.partsBodyNumberColorTooltip: Number color of ordered lists inside the part (numbers are set bold). Inherits the ordered lists color
Sandbox.partsOrderedListsInfo: Overrides applied on top of the document's ordered lists inside the part (after the number color).
Sandbox.partsUnorderedListsInfo: Overrides applied on top of the document's unordered lists inside the part (after the bullet color).
Sandbox.headerFooterPlaceholderNumberHan: Number in Chinese numerals (一, 十二)
Sandbox.headerFooterPlaceholderAttrHint: inserts a heading attribute (# Title '{key="value"}'); in headers and footers, that of the current chapter
Sandbox.headerFooterPlaceholderMarkHint: first / last guide word of the page: a heading level (h1–h6) or a paragraph style, whose entries mark the page with their bold opening words
Sandbox.warningsHeaderFooterUnknownPlaceholderDe: This placeholder name is not recognized and will be left as-is.
Sandbox.warningsHeaderFooterMetadataMissingDetai: The metadata referenced by this placeholder is not set — it will render empty.
Sandbox.resourceTypeDeleteUsageOne: 1 resource uses this type and will be left without a valid type.
Sandbox.resourceTypeDeleteUsageMany: __count__ resources use this type and will be left without a valid type.
Sandbox.resourceTypeCaptionStyleHint: Only the fields you change here replace the global caption style for this type; the rest is inherited.
Sandbox.resourceTypeCaptionStyleResetConfirm: Remove the caption style override for this type?
Sandbox.resourcesDropToUpload: Drop images or SVGs to upload
Sandbox.resourceDeleteReferenced: __id__ is referenced __count__ times in the document. Delete anyway?
Sandbox.resourceIdHintDuplicate: Another resource already uses this id.
Sandbox.resourceCaptionHint: Write \\ (or end a line with a backslash) to start a new line; a plain line break counts as a space.
Sandbox.resourceNotePlaceholder: Source line, credits… (same inline formatting as the caption)
Sandbox.resourceNoteHint: Set in a smaller run under the resource; styled by the Note group of the Captions section. \\ starts a new line, as in the caption.
Sandbox.resourceAltHint: Describes the resource for screen readers.
Sandbox.resourcePlacementHintPage: Floats full width across both columns.
Sandbox.resourcePlacementHintRotated: Turned a quarter turn on a page of its own, flush to the spine; a table too wide for one page continues on the next.
Sandbox.resourceTableStyleHint: Named styles are defined in Settings › Figures & tables › Table styles
Sandbox.uploadSvgInvalid: Not a valid SVG file. Choose a file saved as SVG from a drawing program.
Sandbox.uploadSvgFailed: Failed to store the SVG. The browser's storage may be full: remove images or fonts you no longer use and try again.
Sandbox.uploadSvgDrop: Drop an SVG here or click to upload
Sandbox.svgSourceHint: Only the content of text elements is editable (tinted). Each change is saved as a new file and re-renders the figure; click text in the preview to jump here.
Sandbox.svgSourceMissing: The SVG file is not available in storage.
Sandbox.svgSourceInvalid: The edited SVG is not well-formed; the change was not saved.
Sandbox.svgSourceNoText: This SVG has no text nodes to edit.
Sandbox.svgSourceSaveFailed: Could not save the SVG. The browser's storage may be full: remove images or fonts you no longer use and try again.
Sandbox.svgSourceHintUnlocked: The whole source is editable: coordinates, colours, structure. Each change is saved as a new file and re-renders the figure; a malformed SVG is not saved. Lock again to go back to text-only editing.
Sandbox.resourcePdfMasterHint: Optional single-page PDF with the same figure as vectors (the original Illustrator or PDF export). The PDF output embeds it verbatim instead of the SVG; ignored in single-ink mode. Editing the SVG source detaches it, so the PDF follows your edits.
Sandbox.uploadPdfMasterDrop: Drop a single-page PDF here or click to attach
Sandbox.uploadPdfMasterInvalid: Not a valid PDF file. Choose a .pdf exported by your drawing or layout program.

Sandbox.uploadImageInvalid: Not an image file. Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF file.
Sandbox.uploadImageFailed: Failed to store the image. The browser's storage may be full: remove images or fonts you no longer use and try again.
Sandbox.uploadImageDrop: Drop an image here or click to upload
Sandbox.tableEditorPasteConfirm: Replace the whole table with the pasted data?
Sandbox.tableEditorEmpty: Empty table. Add a row, or paste tab/comma-separated data.
Sandbox.tableEditorNavHelp: Tab / arrows to move · Shift+arrows to select
Sandbox.tableEditorColumnWidthsHint: Relative weights, one per column — 2, 1, 1 gives the first column half the width. Empty = equal widths.
Sandbox.tableEditorImageEmpty: Upload an image or SVG resource first
Sandbox.tableEditorImageWidthHint: Percentage of the cell width the image takes; text runs under it.
Sandbox.tableBodyAlternateFillTooltip: Fills every second body row with its own color, counting from the first row after the header. A cell's own background still wins, and a table split across pages keeps each row's stripe.
Sandbox.tableHeaderLetterSpacingTooltip: Extra space after every letter of the header cells, spaces included (tracking). Capitals usually want a little; a negative value tightens the letters
Sandbox.tableHeaderTextTransformTooltip: Set the header cells in capitals. References keep their label
Sandbox.tableRulesTooltip: Which rules to stroke: the full cell grid, horizontal rules only, the outer frame only, or none
Sandbox.tableOverflow: When a table does not fit
Sandbox.tableOverflowTooltip: A table taller than the page can continue on the following pages (repeating its header rows and marking the caption as continued), keep only the rows that fit, or be left out.
Sandbox.tableOverflowClip: Keep only the rows that fit
Sandbox.tableContinuedSuffixTooltip: Appended to the caption of every continued part, e.g. "Table 6-4. Title (cont.)".
Sandbox.tableBorderRadiusTooltip: Rounds the outer frame of the table. Cell fills are clipped to it; a table split across pages rounds the top of its first part and the bottom of its last
Sandbox.tableStylesResetConfirm: Remove every table style? Tables that use one go back to the document table style.
Sandbox.tableStylesEmpty: No table styles. Add one and pick it in a table resource to give that table its own look; unset fields inherit Tables.
Sandbox.tableStyleDeleteConfirm: Delete this table style? Tables that use it go back to the document table style.
Sandbox.tableStyleIdHintDuplicate: Another table style already uses this id.
Sandbox.tableStyleUsageHint: Pick it in a table resource (Resources panel). Unset fields inherit Tables
Sandbox.captionLabelNumberGapTooltip: What stands between the label and the number, in the caption and in the references: a no-break space (Figure 1.7) or nothing (图1-1).
Sandbox.captionLabelSeparatorTooltip: What follows the number, before the description: a full stop and a space (Figure 1.7. Title) or an ideographic space (图1-1　标题).
Sandbox.captionPositionTooltip: Set the caption under the resource (below) or on top of it, as a table heading (above)
Sandbox.captionBarTooltip: Paint a bar behind the caption spanning the block width. Defaults to the main color of the palette
Sandbox.paragraphStylesEmpty: No paragraph styles defined. Add one and wrap paragraphs in :::paragraphs'{'style="…"'}' to use it.
Sandbox.paragraphContainerSpacingTooltip: How the space under a :::paragraphs container meets the block after it. Collapse: the larger of the style’s own space and the paragraph spacing of the text around it, merged with the space the next block keeps above itself, as between two paragraphs. Add: the style’s space alone, with the next block’s space above added under it, as up to postext 1.4. Books saved before postext 1.5 that use these containers open with Add.
Sandbox.paragraphStyleDeleteConfirm: Delete this paragraph style? Containers that reference it will render as body text.
Sandbox.paragraphStyleIdHintDuplicate: Another paragraph style already uses this id.
Sandbox.paragraphStyleIndentTooltip: Indent of every line of each paragraph from the left edge of the column or box. The first-line and hanging indents count from it: 1.5 em here with a 2.5 em hanging indent sets a line of verse at 1.5 em and its turnover at 4 em
Sandbox.paragraphStyleFirstLineIndentTooltip: Indent of the first line of each paragraph. Ignored when the hanging indent is non-zero
Sandbox.paragraphStyleHangingIndentTooltip: Indent applied to every line except the first (bibliographies, glossaries)
Sandbox.paragraphStyleSpaceBetweenTooltip: Vertical gap between consecutive paragraphs in the container. Zero makes entries abut
Sandbox.paragraphStyleMarginTopTooltip: Space above the container; a negative value pulls it up into the space left by the block before it
Sandbox.paragraphStyleMarginBottomTooltip: Minimum space below the container; the text snaps back to the baseline grid after it. A negative value pulls that text up
Sandbox.paragraphStyleSnapToGridTooltip: On: the text after the container snaps back to the baseline grid, the space below being a minimum. Off: the exact space is kept, and the text after it may sit off the grid until the next heading, list end or display formula. It changes nothing inside a box
Sandbox.paragraphStyleTextTransformTooltip: Uppercase sets the paragraphs in capitals, the words of a chip and the label of a reference included. A letter whose capital is longer (ß) stays as written, and maths is left alone
Sandbox.calloutStylesResetConfirm: Remove every callout style and go back to the built-in note style?
Sandbox.calloutStylesEmpty: No callout styles. The built-in note style applies to every :::callout
Sandbox.chipStylesResetConfirm: Remove every chip style and go back to the built-in chip style?
Sandbox.chipStylesEmpty: No chip styles. The built-in chip style applies to every :chip[…]
Sandbox.chipStyleDeleteConfirm: Delete this chip style? Chips using it fall back to the first style
Sandbox.chipStyleIdHintDuplicate: Another style already uses this id
Sandbox.chipStyleFontSizeTooltip: Size of the chip text; em is relative to the surrounding text. Unset: the surrounding size
Sandbox.chipStyleColorTooltip: Unset: the colour of the surrounding text (bold runs keep the bold colour)
Sandbox.chipStyleBorderRadiusTooltip: Clamped to half the box height; em is relative to the chip text
Sandbox.chipStylePaddingYTooltip: Paints outside the line box and never changes the line height, so the baseline grid holds. A box taller than the line pitch touches the chips of the next line (a warning flags it)
Sandbox.chipStylePaddingTopTooltip: Room above the text, in place of the vertical padding. A top padding larger than the bottom one centres a capital or a figure in a round chip (0.2em over 0.05em in most faces)
Sandbox.chipStylePaddingBottomTooltip: Room below the text, in place of the vertical padding
Sandbox.chipStyleGapTooltip: Least room kept between the box and a neighbouring word or chip across a space; justification never narrows it. Nothing is added at a line edge or against punctuation
Sandbox.calloutStyleDeleteConfirm: Delete this callout style? Callouts using it fall back to the first style
Sandbox.calloutStyleIdHintDuplicate: Another style already uses this id
Sandbox.calloutStyleTitleTooltip: Title shown when the fence sets none. Empty = no title
Sandbox.calloutStyleSpanTooltip: Column: the box fits its column. Page: it spans the full content width. The span attribute overrides it per callout
Sandbox.calloutStyleSideAtColumnEnd: Side Box at a Column End
Sandbox.calloutStyleSideAtColumnEndTooltip: Where a side box stands when the text after its fence does not go on in the same column: the column is full, or the break rules move that text to the next page. Beside the text before: at the fence, on this page, sliding up when it does not fit below it; for a gloss written after the passage it explains. Beside the text after: level with the first line of that text, where it goes on; for a line number or a marginal heading written before its line.
Sandbox.calloutStylePlacementTooltip: Here: inline in the text flow. Top or bottom: floated to that band of the page like a resource. Fixed: pinned to page coordinates, out of the column flow
Sandbox.calloutStyleFixedAnchorToTooltip: Frame the box is pinned to: the content area (mirrored on even pages), the page trim box or the bleed box
Sandbox.calloutStyleFixedEdgeTooltip: Corner or side of the frame the box is pinned to
Sandbox.calloutStyleFixedOffsetTooltip: Shift from the anchored position (positive = right / down)
Sandbox.calloutStyleFloatBarrierTooltip: Place every figure or table referenced before this box ahead of it, so no float escapes past the end of the chapter (use on a closing "key points" box)
Sandbox.calloutStyleKeepTogetherTooltip: Keep the box whole: when it does not fit it moves whole to the next column or page — only a box taller than a full column splits. Turn off to let any box break between its items or between the lines of a paragraph — the part that fits closes the column or page and the rest continues in a box without the title or icon
Sandbox.calloutStyleSplitMinLines: Lines kept on each side of a split
Sandbox.calloutStyleSplitMinLinesTooltip: A split box (keep together off, or a box taller than a full column) keeps at least this many text lines (or one figure, table or formula) on both sides of the cut, and a cut inside a paragraph or list item leaves at least the lines Columns › Lines of a paragraph at a box cut sets (two by default; this value when it is lower); when no cut can, the box moves whole
Sandbox.calloutStyleWidthTooltip: Fill: the available width. Auto: shrink-wraps the title for badge-like callouts (children are ignored)
Sandbox.calloutStyleBackgroundTooltip: Fill the box with a background colour
Sandbox.calloutStyleStripeTooltip: Solid band along one edge of the box. A side stripe narrows the content; a top stripe shortens it
Sandbox.calloutStyleIconKindTooltip: Drawn beside the title: a text glyph or an SVG/bitmap resource. With a side stripe the icon is centred over the stripe; otherwise it takes its own column
Sandbox.calloutStyleIconGlyphTooltip: Character(s) drawn as the icon, e.g. ! or ✎
Sandbox.calloutStyleIconResourceTooltip: SVG or bitmap resource from the Resources panel drawn as the icon
Sandbox.calloutStyleIconPositionTooltip: Inline: in a column of its own left of the title and content (or centred on the side stripe). Corner: a badge on a top corner of the box, half over the border, taking no room from the content
Sandbox.calloutStyleIconCornerSideTooltip: Right and left are fixed; outer and inner follow the page parity when the margins are mirrored
Sandbox.calloutStyleIconWidthTooltip: Width of the icon box when it is not square (a wide strip of icons); the picture is fitted into width × size. Unset: same as the size
Sandbox.calloutStyleMarkerKindTooltip: Drawn outside the box, in a column on its left: a text glyph or an SVG/bitmap resource, with an optional vertical rule between it and the box
Sandbox.calloutStyleMarkerGapTooltip: Space between the marker column (after the rule) and the box
Sandbox.calloutStyleMarkerRuleTooltip: Vertical rule between the marker and the box
Sandbox.calloutStyleMarkerRuleLengthTooltip: Minimum length; the rule always spans at least the box height and is centred on it
Sandbox.calloutStyleLabelTooltip: A small tab on the top edge of the box printing the label attribute of the fence (the number of a numbered box). Off: no tab even when the attribute is given
Sandbox.calloutStyleLabelOffsetTooltip: How far the top of the tab rises above the top edge of the box; half its height centres it on the edge
Sandbox.calloutStyleLabelIconTooltip: SVG or bitmap resource set beside the tab, on the side away from the corner
Sandbox.calloutStyleLabelRuleTooltip: A rule along the top edge of the box from the far corner up to the tab (or its icon)
Sandbox.calloutStyleTitleGapTooltip: Space between the title and the first block, and between the icon column and the content
Sandbox.calloutStyleTitleIndentTooltip: Extra indent of the title from the inner left edge of the box (room for a corner badge)
Sandbox.calloutStyleTitleLineHeightTooltip: Leading of the title’s lines; em counts the title’s own size. On the body leading, a box stays a whole number of lines and its title sits on the grid. Default 1.2em
Sandbox.calloutStyleBodyHint: Unset fields inherit the document body text
Sandbox.calloutStyleBodyBoldColorTooltip: Colour of the bold runs inside the box (a key term set off in the box colour). Inherits the body text bold colour
Sandbox.calloutStyleListsHint: Unset fields inherit the unordered list settings
Sandbox.calloutStyleMarginBottomTooltip: Minimum space below the box; the text snaps back to the baseline grid after it
Sandbox.calloutStyleSnapToGridTooltip: On: the text after the box snaps back to the baseline grid, rounding the space below up to whole grid lines. Off: the box keeps its exact bottom margin (stacked boxes sit exactly apart) and the text after it may sit off the grid until the next heading or list end
Sandbox.calloutStyleColumnGapTooltip: Gap between the columns of a :::columns group inside the box
Sandbox.diagramSingleInkTooltip: Recolor SVG diagrams to tints of one ink so they reproduce faithfully when printing with a single color
Sandbox.diagramInkColorTooltip: The ink diagrams are recolored with. Defaults to the main color of the palette
Sandbox.balanceMaxLinesAfterListTooltip: Maximum extra grid lines added after a single list end
Sandbox.balanceMaxLinesAfterFloatTooltip: Maximum extra grid lines added under a figure or table that heads the column
Sandbox.debugWarningsDesignIssuesTooltip: Report design slots whose elements reference a missing anchor, a missing resource or form an anchor cycle
Sandbox.documentLocaleTooltip: Language of the text. The hyphenation locale falls back to it, and the built-in strings follow it: figure and table names, continuation marks, index labels. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is set without hyphenation. Defaults to the interface language
Sandbox.bodyDocumentLocaleMoved: The document language is set under Writing system, with the writing mode and the binding.
Sandbox.headerFooterElementTextWidthTooltip: Width of the element box: shrink-wrap the text, span the container, or a fixed width the text wraps or ellipsizes at
Sandbox.headerFooterElementTextHeightTooltip: Height of the element box: the text height, the container, or a fixed height the text is aligned within
Sandbox.headerFooterElementMaxWidthTooltip: Cap for a content-fitted width: the element still shrinks to its text, but wraps or ellipsizes past this width, leaving room for elements anchored to it. 0 = no cap
Sandbox.headerFooterElementVerticalAlignTooltip: Where the text sits inside a box taller than its lines
Sandbox.headerFooterElementLineHeightTooltip: Leading of the lines: a multiple of the font size (em), or the distance between baselines (pt, mm)
Sandbox.headerFooterElementLetterSpacingTooltip: Extra space added after every character (tracking); negative tightens the letters
Sandbox.headerFooterElementTextTransformTooltip: Letter-case transform applied to the resolved text
Sandbox.headerFooterElementDirectionTooltip: A horizontal rule runs along the width; a vertical rule runs down the height, its thickness measured across
Sandbox.headerFooterElementLengthTooltip: Length of a vertical rule: the full container height or a fixed length
Sandbox.paragraphStyleBoldColorTooltip: Colour of bold runs inside the style. Inherits the body text bold colour
Sandbox.paragraphStyleItalicColorTooltip: Colour of italic runs inside the style. Inherits the body text italic colour, not the style colour
Sandbox.resourceTypePlacementHint: Placement of the resources of this type that do not set their own. Unset fields fall back to the built-in automatic column float.
Sandbox.resourceTypePlacementResetConfirm: Reset the default placement of this type?
Sandbox.resourceTypePlacementPositionTop: Top of a column or page
Sandbox.resourceTypePlacementPositionBottom: Bottom of a column or page
Sandbox.resourceTypePlacementWidthTooltip: Share of the column (or page) width the resource takes, as a float or embedded inline; 100% is the whole width

Sandbox.headingStylePaletteInfo: Palette colours recoloured on the design slots of the pages of this section, like the palette attribute of a part.
Sandbox.crossRefsDefaultStyleTooltip: What a :ref to a heading or an anchor prints when it sets no style=. The label and number name a numbered heading ("section 3.2"); an unnumbered one is named by its title, an anchor by its text.

Sandbox.indexSeparatorTooltip: Printed between the term and its first page number
Sandbox.indexRangeSeparatorTooltip: Printed between the first and last page of a range
Sandbox.indexMergeRangesTooltip: 12, 13, 14 prints as 12–14. Main (bold) pages are never joined

Sandbox.indexMainTooltip: A mark with the main flag (:index'{'term="…" main'}') points at the principal discussion of the term

Sandbox.indexGroupsEnabledTooltip: Print the head of each group of entries: its letter, pinyin initial or stroke count
Sandbox.indexGroupsMarginTopTooltip: Space above each letter group, head or not. Default: one line of the index
Sandbox.tocInfo: What a :::toc directive prints. Every typographic field inherits the body text.
Sandbox.tocLevelsInfo: Heading levels listed, each with its entry typography. Default: level 1 only.
Sandbox.tocLevelDeleteConfirm: Remove this level from the contents?

Sandbox.tocEntryLineHeightTooltip: Leading of the entry lines, title and subtitle alike. Defaults to the body line height so the contents sit on the grid

PlainLanguage.heading: In short
PlainLanguage.home: Postext is free, open-source software that lays out the pages of books, magazines and reports. You write text with a few simple marks, and Postext turns it into finished pages, like the pages of a printed book. It follows rules that printers have used for centuries, so the text is easy to read. The pages can go on a website, in an app, or into a PDF ready to print. It is made for writers, publishers, designers and developers.
PlainLanguage.privacy: This website does not collect your personal data. It keeps one small file, called a cookie, in your browser to remember whether you accepted cookies. There are no analytics or advertising cookies today, and if that changes you will be asked first. You can ask to see or delete your data at any time through the project's page on GitHub.
PlainLanguage.cookies: A cookie is a small file that a website keeps in your browser. This site uses only one. It remembers what you chose in the cookie banner and lasts one year. The site needs it to work, so it cannot be switched off, but you can delete it in your browser settings. There are no cookies for tracking or advertising.
PlainLanguage.license: You can use Postext for free and for any purpose, paid work included. You can copy it, change it, share it and sell what you make with it. The one condition is to keep the copyright and licence notice in every copy of the code. The software comes with no guarantee, and its authors are not responsible if something goes wrong.

AccessibilityStatement.metaDescription: The accessibility target of postext.dev (WCAG 2.2 AAA), the reading preferences you can set, keyboard use and how to report a problem.
AccessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility
AccessibilityStatement.targetText: We aim for this website and the Sandbox to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AAA, in English, Spanish and Chinese, in the light and the dark theme. Every page is checked with automated tests (axe-core plus our own checks for the AAA criteria) and walked through with the keyboard.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsText: The site sets its prose justified and hyphenated, like the books Postext makes. If you find that harder to read, the book icon in the menu bar opens the reading preferences. They apply to every page of the site and are kept in this browser.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsTheme: Theme: light or dark. It is the same setting as the switch in the menu bar; with no choice made, the site follows your system.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsAlign: Text alignment: justified as designed, or left-aligned with no hyphenation.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsSpacing: Line spacing: as designed, or 1.8 lines with paragraph gaps one and a half times the line spacing.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsWidth: Line length: as designed, or 80 characters at most (40 in Chinese), with two-column text set in one column.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsColors: Colours: the theme's own, high contrast (black on white, or white on black in the dark theme) or warm paper.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsZoom: Text can be enlarged to 200% with the browser's zoom and pages still fit the window without scrolling sideways.
AccessibilityStatement.prefsHere: You can also set them in the panel on this page.
AccessibilityStatement.sandboxTargets: In the Sandbox, buttons and fields are compact by default so the editor can show more at once. The hand icon at the bottom of its left bar (at the top on a phone) turns on large buttons and fields, every one at least 44 × 44 pixels. It starts on with a touch screen and is kept in this browser.
AccessibilityStatement.keyboardTab: Tab and Shift+Tab move between links and controls, and an outline shows where you are.
AccessibilityStatement.keyboardSkip: The first Tab stop on every page is a link that skips to the main content.
AccessibilityStatement.keyboardActivate: Enter or Space activates buttons; the arrow keys move between the choices of a group.
AccessibilityStatement.keyboardEscape: Esc closes menus, the search window and the reading preferences, and returns focus to the button that opened them.
AccessibilityStatement.keyboardSearch: Ctrl+K (⌘K on a Mac) opens the documentation search.
AccessibilityStatement.limitationsIntro: These parts of the site do not meet the target yet:
limitations: The two narrated videos have no sign-language interpretation (WCAG 1.2.6) and no extended audio description (1.2.7). Each video has a full transcript under the player that describes what happens on screen as well as the narration.
The video caption tracks hold speech only and are labelled as subtitles; sound and music cues are not yet captioned.
There is no Chinese cut of the videos: Chinese pages play the English video with a Chinese transcript.
The page preview in the Sandbox's Canvas tab is a picture of each page. Its text is in the HTML tab and in the Text panel, where screen readers can read it.
Books you export as PDF from the Sandbox are tagged for accessibility, but how readable they are depends on the content and design you give them.
AccessibilityStatement.reportText: If something on the site is hard or impossible to use, please open an issue on <issuesLink>GitHub</issuesLink>. Tell us the page, what you were trying to do, and the browser and assistive technology you use.
